title: Physics
description: ICSE Class X Physics: one theory paper of 2 hours carrying 80 marks plus 20 marks internal assessment of practical work.

syllabusBaselines.source: CISCE, ICSE Examination Year 2027 Regulations and Syllabuses - Physics (www.cisce.org), corroborated by Oswal Publishers' 2026-27 reproduction.
syllabusBaselines.note: Verified October 2026. Units: Force; Work, Power and Energy; Machines; Refraction of Light; Refraction through a Lens; Spectrum; Sound; Electricity and Electromagnetism.

sections.title: Physics
sections.description: Mechanics, optics, sound and electricity units.

chapters.title: Force
chapters.blurb: Moment of force, turning forces, centre of gravity, uniform circular motion, equilibrium.

chapters.title: Work, Power and Energy
chapters.blurb: Work, energy forms, KE and PE, power, transformation and conservation of energy.

chapters.title: Machines
chapters.blurb: Lever classes, MA, VR and efficiency; pulleys and inclined plane.

chapters.title: Refraction of Light
chapters.blurb: Laws of refraction, refractive index, critical angle, total internal reflection and prisms.

chapters.title: Refraction through a Lens
chapters.blurb: Convex and concave lenses, ray diagrams, magnification, power of a lens.

chapters.title: Spectrum
chapters.blurb: Dispersion, electromagnetic spectrum, scattering of light and its consequences.

chapters.title: Sound
chapters.blurb: Reflection of sound, echoes, natural and forced vibrations, resonance, loudness, pitch and quality.

chapters.title: Electricity and Electromagnetism
chapters.blurb: Ohm's law, resistance combinations, power, household circuits, electromagnets and the d.c. motor.
